title: Toolchain manifest
description: Release evidence for the Nix-owned toolchain closure (ADR-0002). Rendered by tools/build/nix/manifest.nix, committed at tools/build/nix/toolchain-manifest.json, and asserted by the flake check of the same name. Records resolved versions and the nixpkgs revision rather than store paths: a store path moves on any rebuild of any dependency, so a path-keyed manifest churns without carrying more information.

schema.description: Manifest format version. Bumped only when a consumer would break.

nixpkgs.description: The nixpkgs revision from flake.lock. With the tool versions below, this is what makes the closure recoverable.

pins.description: The declared pins from tools/build/nix/versions.nix, so a versions.nix edit that no compatibility file mirrors also shows up as manifest drift.

cxx.description: Stable configuration evidence for the registered Nix C/C++ toolchain. Host-specific store paths remain in the per-system bundle manifest.

darwinSystemLibraries.description: SDK-adjacent Darwin libraries supplied by pinned nixpkgs derivations to strict Bazel link actions.

tools.description: Resolved versions of the default devShell's packages.

ciTools.description: Resolved versions of what the .#ci shell adds on top of the default shell — the tools that gate a pull request.

version.description: A resolved package version as nixpkgs reports it.

exactVersion.description: A pin that names one release.

languageLevel.description: A major.minor language level, deliberately less precise than the toolchain that implements it.

major.description: A major version, held as a number because the source attrset holds it as one.
